facts.fact: Le Sahel: minister received provisionally on 14 Nov 2025 the 1,031 km fibre sections (Arlit-Assamaka 220 km, Diffa-N'Guigmi 186, Zinder-Magaria 117, Niamey-Dosso-Gaya 300, Niamey-Makalondi 118), laid by the LORYNE group with AfDB support; commissioning described as forthcoming.

facts.fact: Minister states the government's objective is to guarantee all operators free, equitable and transparent access to the very-high-speed infrastructure; stated as an aim, not as a described lease or wholesale arrangement.
